hints.title: Dual Swap Neighborhood
hints.text: Two numbers are almost equal under up to two swaps if generating all numbers reachable within two swaps from one number produces the other.

hints.title: Bounded Neighborhood Size
hints.text: Since numbers have at most 7 digits, the number of distinct forms generated by at most two disjoint or overlapping swaps is bounded by approximately three hundred.

hints.title: Frequency Matching
hints.text: For each incoming number, generate its candidate variations, accumulate matches from a frequency hash table, and then register the number itself into the table.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash table lookups for precomputed digit swap mutations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) deep permutation comparisons times out for n = 5000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Generates 2-swap variations efficiently and checks membership in a frequency map.
